newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel to let in 10,000 Arab workers from Gaza.
newsitem.headline: Israel to let in 10,000 Arab workers from Gaza.

text.p: Israeli authorities will allow 10,000 Palestinians to enter the Jewish state from the Gaza Strip on Wednesday for work, easing a two-week closure on the area, the army said on Tuesday.
"On Wednesnday at 4 a.m. (0200 GMT), 10,000 workers from Gaza will be allowed into Israel for work," an army spokeswoman said.
Israel imposed the closure last month when clashes erupted in the West Bank and Gaza over a second entrance Israel opened to an archaeological tunnel near a Moslem holy site in Jerusalem's Old City.
Fifteen Israelis and 59 Palestinians were killed in the violence.
Around 23,000 Palestinians from Gaza and West Bank worked in Israel daily before the closure was imposed.
